keyPoints.en: Choose a clear, specific local issue (e.g. recycling, traffic, river pollution); get permission and plan for safety.
keyPoints.bm: Pilih isu setempat yang jelas dan khusus (cth. kitar semula, lalu lintas, pencemaran sungai); dapatkan kebenaran dan rancang keselamatan.

keyPoints.en: Objectives are specific aims starting with verbs such as identify, explain, suggest.
keyPoints.bm: Objektif ialah matlamat khusus yang bermula dengan kata kerja seperti mengenal pasti, menerangkan, mencadangkan.

keyPoints.en: Observation, interview, questionnaire, measurement and document study; use more than one method.
keyPoints.bm: Pemerhatian, temu bual, soal selidik, pengukuran dan kajian dokumen; gunakan lebih daripada satu kaedah.

keyPoints.en: Record primary and secondary data; present them in tables, graphs, maps and photos; calculate totals and percentages.
keyPoints.bm: Rekod data primer dan sekunder; persembahkannya dalam jadual, graf, peta dan gambar; kira jumlah dan peratus.

keyPoints.en: Report: introduction and objectives, study area and methods, findings, conclusion and suggestions, references and appendices.
keyPoints.bm: Laporan: pengenalan dan objektif, kawasan kajian dan kaedah, dapatan, rumusan dan cadangan, rujukan dan lampiran.

tip.en: Make sure every conclusion is backed by your data.
tip.bm: Pastikan setiap rumusan disokong oleh data anda.
